verdict.rationale: Unity's first-party in-editor AI Assistant package (com.unity.ai.assistant) is documented for creating assets, automating workflows, analyzing performance, and performing project actions through natural-language prompts. Assistant messages are metered through Unity Credits, so this is a built-in capability users can delegate work to. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what agentic actions the Assistant can execute autonomously, hands-on or independent corroboration, and a stable non-beta release (the package is 2.20.0-pre.1 and part of AI tools beta).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use it to create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance, and perform project actions using natural-language prompts.
send a message to the Assistant, you spend Unity Credits from your organization's monthly allocation
packages.unity.com/com.unity.ai.assistant resolves the in-editor AI Assistant package
